instruction: Find the camera orientation that maximizes the silhouette area of `Target`, render `/home/user/Desktop/output/optimal.png`, and save `/home/user/Desktop/answer.blend`. ## Requirements 1. `/home/user/Desktop/answer.blend` exists and opens in Blender. 2. Scene contains a `Target` object (mesh) centered near the origin. 3. Scene contains a `Camera` object (type CAMERA) as the active `scene.camera`. 4. `/home/user/Desktop/output/optimal.png` exists. 5. The rendered PNG is exactly 256x256. 6. The submitted render has silhouette area (alpha > 0.5 pixel count) >= 1000 pixels (object is visible, not edge-on). 7. The submitted camera orientation yields a silhouette area within 2% of the true analytical optimum (camera on the +Y axis at distance 5, looking at the origin, orthographic). [Software] Launch Blender by running `blender` from a terminal. On this machine, use `/opt/blender/blender` for Blender command-line or background runs.
